steps.name: Plan Builder
steps.system: You are a career mentor for engineering students.
steps.user:
Build a 4-week learning plan that closes these skill gaps. The student can study at most 10 hours per week. For every week give the focus skills, the learning resources with links, practice tasks and the hours.

Skill gaps (JSON): [{"skill": "Responsive Web Design & Flexbox/Grid", "current_level": "none", "required_level": "intermediate", "priority": "high"}, {"skill": "Git & GitHub", "current_level": "none", "required_level": "beginner", "priority": "high"}, {"skill": "Browser Developer Tools & Debugging", "current_level": "none", "required_level": "beginner", "priority": "high"}, {"skill": "RESTful APIs & Fetch/Axios", "current_level": "none", "required_level": "beginner", "priority": "medium"}, {"skill": "State Management (Redux Toolkit, Context API)", "current_level": "none", "required_level": "beginner", "priority": "medium"}, {"skill": "TypeScript", "current_level": "none", "required_level": "beginner", "priority": "medium"}, {"skill": "CSS Preprocessors (Sass/SCSS) or Tailwind CSS", "current_level": "none", "required_level": "beginner", "priority": "low"}, {"skill": "Basic Unit Testing (Jest, React Testing Library)", "current_level": "none", "required_level": "beginner", "priority": "low"}, {"skill": "Web Accessibility (a11y) & SEO Basics", "current_level": "none", "required_level": "beginner", "priority": "low"}]

Return JSON only in this format:
{"weeks": [{"week": 1, "focus_skills": ["..."], "resources": [{"title": "...", "url": "..."}], "practice_tasks": ["..."], "total_hours": 0}]}

practice_tasks: Initialize a local Git repository, make regular commits, and push a project to GitHub.
Build a responsive landing page layout using CSS Flexbox for navigation and CSS Grid for the main content sections.
Use Browser Developer Tools to inspect DOM elements, debug CSS layout issues, and monitor console logs.
Style the Week 1 landing page using Tailwind CSS utility classes.
Write a JavaScript script using the Fetch API to pull data from a public REST API (e.g., JSONPlaceholder) and render it to the DOM.
Audit the landing page using Lighthouse in Chrome DevTools to fix basic accessibility (aria labels, contrast) and SEO meta tags.
Convert basic JavaScript functions and component props into TypeScript interfaces and types.
Implement a React Context or Redux Toolkit store to manage global application state (e.g., theme toggler or shopping cart items).

focus_skills: Basic Unit Testing (Jest, React Testing Library)
practice_tasks: Write unit tests using Jest for utility functions created in previous weeks.
Write component integration tests using React Testing Library to verify user interactions and proper rendering.
